title: Everyday Persian Idioms and Courtesy Expressions
summary: Essential phrases like 'دستت درد نکنه' (Thank you) and 'خسته نباشی'.
explanation: Native Persian speakers use rich cultural expressions for thanking, greeting, and showing affection.

example_translations.ex_exp_1: Thank you so much, you were very kind!

common_error_explanations.err_exp_1: Use authentic everyday idioms like 'دستت درد نکنه' instead of literal translations.
